views.name: orders_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  order_status,
  order_purchase_timestamp,
  order_approved_at,
  order_delivered_carrier_date,
  order_delivered_customer_date,
  order_estimated_delivery_date
FROM olist_orders
views.description: Canonicalized orders table: preserves order-level identifiers and timestamps, casts timestamps to ISO text (no timezone conversion) and exposes key columns for joins. Use this as the deterministic order-level base for downstream joins and time-based aggregations. | Use for: order lifecycle metrics (time-to-approve, time-to-deliver); join base for payments/items/reviews by order; orders time-series and status breakdowns

views.name: order_items_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  order_item_id,
  product_id,
  seller_id,
  shipping_limit_date,
  price,
  freight_value
FROM olist_order_items
views.description: One row per order line item preserving item-level identifiers, product and seller references, price and freight. Use for item-level aggregations, price analytics and join paths to products and sellers. | Use for: line-item revenue, freight and seller performance; per-item shipping SLAs vs order dates; join to products and sellers for enrichment

views.name: orders_payments_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(*) AS payment_parts_count,
  SUM(payment_value) AS payment_value_total,
  MAX(payment_installments) AS payment_installments_max
FROM olist_order_payments
GROUP BY order_id
views.description: Aggregated payment measures at the order level: total payment_value, count of payment parts, and max/installment info. Use when you need one row per order with payment totals and basic payment composition. | Use for: order-level revenue and payment composition; reconciling order totals vs item totals; payment method mixes when joined to payment_type

views.name: orders_items_revenue_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  order_id,
  COUNT(*) AS items_count,
  SUM(price) AS items_price_total,
  SUM(freight_value) AS freight_value_total
FROM olist_order_items
GROUP BY order_id
views.description: Order-level aggregation of item revenue: total item price, total freight and number of items. Use to compare against payments or to compute average item price per order. | Use for: order revenue reconciliation; average freight or price per order; orders with many items or high freight

views.name: order_reviews_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  review_id,
  order_id,
  review_score,
  review_comment_title,
  review_comment_message,
  review_creation_date,
  review_answer_timestamp
FROM olist_order_reviews
views.description: One row per review preserving review score, message and review timestamps for join to orders. Use to analyze review distributions and link feedback to orders. | Use for: linking reviews to orders and customers; average review score by product/seller when joined downstream; review response time and timelines

views.name: products_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_category_name,
  product_name_lenght,
  product_description_lenght,
  product_photos_qty,
  product_weight_g,
  product_length_cm,
  product_height_cm,
  product_width_cm
FROM olist_products
views.description: Product dimension at one row per product with descriptive attributes and size/weight metrics. Use for enrichment of items, category-level aggregation, and mapping to translations. | Use for: product sizing/weight distributions; category-level sales when joined to items; product completeness/quality checks

views.name: sellers_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  seller_id,
  seller_zip_code_prefix,
  seller_city,
  seller_state
FROM olist_sellers
views.description: Seller dimension at one row per seller preserving location fields for joins and seller-level aggregations. | Use for: seller geography analysis; seller performance when joined to items/orders

views.name: customers_core
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_unique_id,
  customer_zip_code_prefix,
  customer_city,
  customer_state
FROM olist_customers
views.description: Customer dimension at one row per customer preserving unique buyer identifier and location fields. Use for customer-level segmentation and joins to orders. | Use for: customer geography and repeat buyer analyses; join to orders for lifetime value and cohorts

views.name: orders_with_payments_items
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.customer_id,
  o.order_status,
  o.order_purchase_timestamp,
  p.payment_parts_count,
  p.payment_value_total,
  i.items_count,
  i.items_price_total,
  i.freight_value_total
FROM orders_core o
LEFT JOIN orders_payments_agg p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
LEFT JOIN orders_items_revenue_agg i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
views.description: Denormalized order-level row that joins orders to aggregated payments and aggregated item revenue. Useful when you need a single row per order with payment totals and item totals for reconciliation or order-level KPIs. | Use for: order reconciliation and KPI dashboards; identify orders with missing payments or items; compute order-level profitability proxies

views.name: product_category_translation_core
views.description: Translation lookup for product categories to English. Use to normalize category labels when joining product dimension to human-readable categories. | Use for: map native category names to English; group products by translated category

views.name: products_with_translation
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_category_name,
  t.product_category_name_english,
  p.product_name_lenght,
  p.product_description_lenght,
  p.product_photos_qty,
  p.product_weight_g,
  p.product_length_cm,
  p.product_height_cm,
  p.product_width_cm
FROM products_core p
LEFT JOIN product_category_translation_core t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
views.description: Product dimension enriched with translated category name. One row per product including both original and English category labels for reporting and grouping. | Use for: category-level sales with English labels; product catalog reporting and completeness checks

views.name: geolocation_sample_dedup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
  AVG(geolocation_lat) AS geolocation_lat,
  AVG(geolocation_lng) AS geolocation_lng,
  MAX(geolocation_city) AS geolocation_city,
  MAX(geolocation_state) AS geolocation_state
FROM olist_geolocation
GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
views.description: One representative geolocation row per geolocation_zip_code_prefix using the average latitude/longitude and a sample city/state. This prevents multiplicative joins when enriching by zip prefix. Use when joining geolocation by zip prefix to customers or sellers. | Use for: map customers/sellers to approximate coordinates; visualization and distance calculations by zip prefix

views.name: seller_item_counts_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  seller_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_served_count,
  COUNT(*) AS items_sold_count,
  SUM(price) AS items_revenue_total,
  SUM(freight_value) AS freight_value_total
FROM olist_order_items
GROUP BY seller_id
views.description: Seller-level aggregates computed from order items: number of distinct orders served, total items sold, total item revenue and total freight. Use for seller performance summaries and joins to seller dimension. | Use for: seller revenue and volume leaderboards; join to seller location for regional performance

views.name: customer_orders_agg
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  o.customer_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_count,
  MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_purchase_timestamp,
  MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_order_purchase_timestamp,
  SUM(coalesce(p.payment_value_total,0)) AS payments_value_total,
  SUM(coalesce(i.items_price_total,0)) AS items_price_total
FROM orders_core o
LEFT JOIN orders_payments_agg p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
LEFT JOIN orders_items_revenue_agg i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
GROUP BY o.customer_id
views.description: Customer-level order aggregates: number of orders, total paid (from payments), total items and first/last order purchase timestamp. Use for lifetime value approximations and cohorting. | Use for: customer lifetime value and recency/frequency analyses; cohort definitions by first purchase date

views.name: order_latest_review_rank
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  review_id,
  order_id,
  review_score,
  review_comment_title,
  review_comment_message,
  review_creation_date,
  review_answer_timestamp,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY review_creation_date DESC) AS review_row_num
FROM olist_order_reviews
views.description: Assigns a ROW_NUMBER per order ordering reviews by review_creation_date descending to pick the latest review per order. Use to deduplicate multiple reviews per order when a single review is required. | Use for: select the latest review per order; de-duplicate reviews when joining to orders

views.name: latest_review_per_order
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  review_id,
  order_id,
  review_score,
  review_comment_title,
  review_comment_message,
  review_creation_date,
  review_answer_timestamp
FROM order_latest_review_rank
WHERE review_row_num = 1
views.description: One row per order with the most recent review (if any). Use when you need a single review per order for join to orders or customers. | Use for: attach single review to order for analytics; calculate average review per order/customer/product
